summary: @onereach/ui-components preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style control-flow-flattened code that downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the bun/bun.exe binary into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js — a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, large numeric constant array with a rotating string decoder). Both files on the install-time execution path are obfuscated. The advertised purpose of the package is a Vue UI-components library, which has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or a math-labeled init script at install time. The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern combined with an opaque, obfuscated payload executed under a non-Node runtime deliberately places the executed code outside the reach of Node-oriented static review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
